info.name: AlphaTheta OMNIS-DUO
info.author: openDJ
info.description: openDJ mapping for the OMNIS-DUO all-in-one in PC control (MIDI) mode: four decks on two channels, the mixer, Beat FX and hot cue pads. Beta: written from AlphaTheta's OMNIS-DUO MIDI message list and rekordbox's OMNIS-DUO mapping, not yet tried on the hardware.
